name: txt2sfx-bridge
description: Local daemon that puts an MCP coding agent in the same room as the txt2sfx playground: validate, render, measure and audition soundline without hosting anything.

scripts.bundle: tsc -b && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/txt2sfx-bridge.mjs --external:node-web-audio-api "--banner:js=#!/usr/bin/env node" && esbuild src/render-child.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/render-child.mjs --external:node-web-audio-api && node scripts/pack-assets.mjs
